title: HermesTV Actor / Person Record
description: Minimal actor/person record for use in catalog metadata and 'More with this actor' recommendations. All URLs must use hermestv.local. Chrome 76 compatible.

actor_id.description: Stable actor identifier in the format actor-NNN (three or more digits).

name.description: Full display name of the actor or person.

photo_url.description: Headshot or publicity photo. Must use hermestv.local domain.

known_for_titles.description: Array of catalog item IDs (id field) for which this actor is prominently known.

bio_short.description: One or two sentence biography displayed in the UI. Hard limit 200 characters.
